Alex: heads up — noticed a small-decode latency regression on canary this morning. p95 jump ~120ms for sessions with a lot of short responses (decode microbatches ~3-6). attaching profile and kernel selection log.
Maria: which model/config? can you paste the kernel log snippet + exact canary id?
Alex: model=redwood-open-10b, seq=1024/streaming decode, canary=canary-42. kernel routing lines:
```
[2025-07-12T09:24:15Z] pick_kernel: decode path -> smallbatch_prefill_fallback (chosen=flash-fused-paged-v2, fallback=flash-variant)
[2025-07-12T09:24:15Z] kv_probe: evict_candidate=slot_7, after_probe=false
[2025-07-12T09:24:15Z] kernel_switch: selected_prefill_variant=true (batch=4, inflight=2)
```
Maria: hmm that log looks like decode is ending up on the prefill-optimized variant. is the selection matrix incorrectly considering continuous-batch as prefill? can you also paste batching metadata?
Alex: batching metadata: `continuous=true, microbatch_size=1, total_batch=4, avg_len=8`. Seems small decode writes are falling into the same branch as prefill due to `continuous && batch_size <=4` rule.
Jamal: we saw something similar last quarter — KV cache probe cost + extra layout transforms when picking prefill-fused for decode. For tiny microbatches the CUDA kernel launch overhead + kv-page prepares beats the optimized decode kernel. That explains the +120ms.
Devon: perfbot flamegraph (canary-42): https://perf.internal/graphs/42. top hits in `kv_page_prepare` and `pack_q_kv` when the prefill path is used. Also noticed fallback from flash-fused-paged-v2 -> paged-atten-compat on small seqs due to a guard on `seq_len % 64`.
Alex: quick mitigation: toggled `runtime.flags.allow_prefill_on_decode=false` on canary-42. deploy-bot: rolled config "allow_prefill_on_decode=false" to canary-42 by Alex at 09:25.
deploy-bot: rollout complete (canary-42).
Jamal: after toggle p95 dropped back to baseline within two minutes. sample window 09:26-09:30 shows p95 delta ~ -130ms. :tada:
Maria: follow-ups — (1) add unit test to kernel selection matrix for continuous vs prefill under microbatch sizes 1..8, (2) add perf alert for decode path when p95 regresses >50ms in 5m window, (3) audit `seq_len` guards that force paged fallback. assigning @Devon for (1), @Alex for (2), @Jamal for (3). deadline EOW.
Alex: will open PR for selection test and alert. thanks for quick triage.
Devon: will triage seq_len guard and propose safer guard thresholds.
Alex: passing to postmortem if it recurs, but rollback + test should be enough for now. :thumbsup:
